title: XOR composition lower bounds for an AND of small De Morgan formulas

standard_prerequisites.name: Classical counting lower bound for a random Boolean function and multiplicative Chernoff bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author imports counting fact [16]; exact Chernoff statement and every source-local matrix, well-mixing, independence/counting calculation retained.

core_obligations: Track the subadditive sum of restricted formula sizes down a top AND layer.
Bound how many inner functions can share a selected subformula using lucky and unlucky matrix rows.
Prove the required random well-mixed family exists by rank counting and random shifted-set intersection bounds.
Count the distinct selected subfunctions to contradict the assumed small formula sizes.
difficulty_reason: Non-routine well-mixed families connect random XOR-composition matrices with a top-down subadditive formula measure. The full family-existence, linear-independence, shifted-intersection and counting arguments are bundled with the main result.
